title: ProjectGameCredentialAdapter
responsibility: Read a game-specific provider key only from the selected project ignored regular credential file.

inputs.name: ProjectGameCredentialAdapter.constructor.root
inputs.description: Local project directory stored as the private root; read() joins it with .env.local on every call and passes it to gitRead for the ls-files and check-ignore checks once the file exists. The constructor does not validate it, and read() never falls back to another project or to ambient environment values.

inputs.name: ProjectGameCredentialAdapter.read.name
inputs.description: Game-provider key name to read on each call, which the type limits to HARNESS_GAME_OPENAI_API_KEY or HARNESS_GAME_DECART_API_KEY; read() does not check it at runtime and matches only a .env.local line that starts with this exact name followed by =. Ambient environment variables with this name are never consulted.

outputs.name: ProjectGameCredentialAdapter.read
outputs.description: The resolved string is the value of the first .env.local line that starts with the requested name followed by =, read only after the ignored and regular-file checks pass, and it is one run of characters with no whitespace or quote characters, with at most one quote stripped from each side. It is never empty: a missing file, a failed check or a missing key rejects the promise with one of the thrown Error messages instead of resolving.

errors.name: Error
errors.description: Plain Error that read() throws with the project-owned configuration message when .env.local is absent or unreadable, when a Git check fails with an error whose code is not 1, or when no line matches the requested name, and with the must-be-ignored message when the file is tracked or not reported as ignored. Once the ignored check passes, the must-be-regular message is thrown for a symbolic link or other non-regular file, and Git failure details are not attached to the configuration message.

outputs.name: ProjectGameCredentialAdapter.constructor
